errors.text_span: This pie chart represents a task taxonomy... The chart contains twelve slices, each labeled with a specific category.
errors.evidence: The chart is not a simple pie chart with twelve slices. It is a nested donut chart with an inner ring of 4 slices and an outer ring with at least 14 sub-category slices.

errors.text_span: The largest slice, colored blue, represents “Perception Layer” and occupies approximately 40.4% of the total area.
errors.evidence: The largest slice is the "Semantic Layer" at 41.2%, not the "Perception Layer" at 40.4%.

errors.text_span: The next largest slice, also blue, is labeled “Semantic Layer” and accounts for roughly 41.2%.
errors.evidence: The "Semantic Layer" is the largest slice, not the "next largest". Additionally, its color is a lighter blue than the "Perception Layer", a distinction not made by saying "also blue".

errors.text_span: “Counting & Statistics” is depicted as a smaller orange slice, representing about 14.1%
errors.evidence: This is completely wrong. The label “Counting & Statistics” is on a dark blue slice in the outer ring, has no percentage value, and is a sub-category of the Perception Layer. The value 14.1% belongs to the "Cultural Layer" in the inner ring. The color is not orange.

errors.text_span: “Environmental Perception & Reasoning” is a small light green slice
errors.evidence: The slice for “Environmental Perception & Reasoning” is colored light blue, not light green.
The value 3.0% does not appear anywhere in the chart. The closest value is 4.3% for the "Signal Layer".

errors.text_span: There are percentage labels inside each slice
errors.evidence: Percentage labels are only present in the four slices of the inner ring, not in all slices.

errors.text_span: the slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of area.
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered by size. For example, the inner ring slices appear in the order of 41.2%, 40.4%, 14.1%, 4.3% which is not a simple ascending or descending order around the circle.
The description completely omits the hierarchical nature of the chart, failing to mention the existence of an inner ring and an outer ring of sub-categories.
The prompt asks to describe each slice, but the description only names 4 categories out of the 18+ distinct labels in the chart, completely ignoring the entire outer ring of sub-categories.
